fields.description: Palm Beach Towers is Nakheel’s three-tower residential destination at the entrance to Palm Jumeirah. Its original apartment releases and later Podium Villas have different layouts and delivery programmes. Tower 3 was announced with furnished one- to three-bedroom residences; the newer podium collection adds two- to four-bedroom villa-style homes.

overview: The original Tower 3 announcement identifies furnished homes and a beach-oriented recreation programme. A separate May 2026 release introduced 16 Podium Villas across Towers Two and Three. Confirm which product, tower and layout is offered before comparing its specification or payment terms.
research.locationNote: At the entrance to Palm Jumeirah, with access to surrounding coastal destinations. Views depend on tower, level and orientation; no universal uninterrupted sea outlook is assumed.
research.priceNote: Property Finder displays a rounded AED 3.7m launch headline and AED 3,701,000 in its detailed data. Its combined page marks developer inventory sold out while listing resales. This historical project reference is not a current quotation or a price for the newer Podium Villas.
research.paymentNote: The original Tower 3 sheet specifies 15% booking; 10% in March 2023, September 2023, March 2024 and September 2024; 5% in March 2025; and 40% on handover. These dated launch terms are historical. Any revised plan, transfer balance and additional charges require written confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The original Tower 3 payment sheet anticipated Q1 2026. Property Finder’s combined page labels January 2026/ready, but its separate Tower 3 record reports December 2026. Nakheel’s May 2026 podium release states H1 2027 specifically for those 16 homes. A single confirmed current date cannot be assigned across the development.
